payload.instruction: Turn the image into a drawing made from chalk
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: Does the edited image show visible progress toward a chalk drawing compared with the source, rather than only unrelated changes?
node.criteria: Pass if the image has a genuine chalk-drawing or hand-rendered stylization, even if photographic detail remains and the result is not convincingly a chalk drawing. Fail if sufficient evidence shows no such requested visual progress. Unknown if the comparison is insufficient to determine this.
node.binding: Compare source and edit for actual drawing-like transformation. Grain, softened outlines, or blur alone are not enough to establish convincing chalk-medium fulfillment, but may accompany genuine partial progress. Do not infer absence from uncertainty.
